events.verdict: Williams (OKC) establishes himself in Williams Jr.'s (MEM) path prior to the contact.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes contact to the ball to dislodge it from Williams' (OKC) possession.
Williams (OKC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Mitchell (OKC) legally contests Spencer's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Caruso (OKC) moves around the screen and the contact with Williams Jr. (MEM) is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Jackson Jr. (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Jackson Jr. reaches in and makes illegal contact to Dort (OKC) while he is in bounds with possession of the ball.
Williams (OKC) legally contests Coward's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
After the release of the shot attempt, Caruso (OKC) follows through and makes marginal contact to Landale's (MEM) head/face that does not affect his shot attempt.
Coward (MEM) moves alongside of Williams' (OKC) path to the basket and maintains a legal guarding position.
Caruso (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position defending Coward (MEM) on the perimeter. Caruso absorbs the arm contact with Coward as Coward moves into his shooting motion.
